proposals.name: Rope Access & Wind Turbine Technicians
proposals.buyer_persona: Industrial climbers, wind turbine technicians, and riggers who take immense pride in working at extreme heights. They love showing off their niche gear (harnesses, descenders) and insider slang on stickers, t-shirts, and social media.
product_angles: Vector SVG packs of high-quality industrial rigging gear (carabiners, descenders, rope setups) for DIY stickers.
Daily Rigging & Hours Logbook on Amazon KDP (essential for maintaining professional IRATA/SPRAT certifications).
Redbubble sticker designs featuring rope access humor ('Gravity is just a habit', 'Certified Knot Tier').
proposals.first_test_product: IRATA/SPRAT Hours Logbook with a technical, rugged cover design on Amazon KDP

proposals.name: Cyberpunk & Sci-Fi Virtual Tabletop (VTT) Assets
proposals.buyer_persona: Game Masters (GMs) running Cyberpunk RED, Shadowrun, or Starfinder on Roll20, Foundry VTT, or Owlbear Arena who are tired of the saturated generic high-fantasy assets and need clean, neon-styled futuristic props.
product_angles: PNG token packs for futuristic terminals, cyberware crates, and holographic interfaces.
Modular grid-aligned floor plan vectors (SVGs) for quick sci-fi corridor generation.
KDP Sci-Fi Campaign planner with custom hex grids and faction tracking sheets.
proposals.first_test_product: Cyberpunk Terminal & Prop PNG Token Pack (50+ assets) for Roll20/Foundry

proposals.name: Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA) Practitioners
proposals.buyer_persona: HEMA sword fighters and history enthusiasts who obsess over medieval combat manuals (Liechtenauer, Fiore dei Liberi, Joachim Meyer). They reject standard fantasy 'mall ninja' tropes and want historical accuracy paired with modern humor.
product_angles: Minimalist vector illustrations (SVGs) of actual historical guard postures (e.g., Vom Tag, Pflug, Alber).
HEMA Sparring & Tournament Logbook on Amazon KDP to track fights, techniques, and weapon maintenance.
Inside joke merchandise on Redbubble emphasizing historical fencing terms ('Zwerchhau solves everything').
proposals.first_test_product: HEMA Sparring Logbook and Combat Tracker on Amazon KDP

proposals.name: Amicales de Sapeurs-Pompiers (Local French Firefighters)
proposals.buyer_persona: French volunteer and professional firefighters managing their local 'Amicale' (association). They design and distribute local calendars, event flyers, and station-branded gifts every year on a tight budget.
product_angles: Customizable SVG vector calendar templates tailored specifically to French fire station layouts.
High-quality vector graphics of French fire trucks (FPT, VSAV, EPA) for local customization.
Ready-to-print funny firefighter quote packages for internal station mugs and apparel.
proposals.first_test_product: French Firefighter SVG Vector Asset Pack (Trucks, emblems, and customizable text fields)

proposals.name: Mycology & Wild Mushroom Foraging
proposals.buyer_persona: Citizen scientists, amateur mycologists, and wild food foragers who spend weekends looking for Chanterelles, Morels, or studying spore prints. They value scientific accuracy and practical field tools.
product_angles: Mushroom Spore Print Logbook on Amazon KDP with dedicated black-backed pages to capture and document white spore prints.
Highly detailed botanical SVG vector packs of regional edible and toxic mushrooms for educational stickers.
Foraging pocket cards / cheat sheets downloadable as printable PDFs.
proposals.first_test_product: The Spore Print Collector's Logbook (KDP format with alternate dark pages)

proposals.name: Zero-Cost Solopreneur Automation Templates (Termux & GitHub Actions)
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie hackers, solo creators, and developers from emerging countries who have no budget for expensive SaaS tools and want to run their entire digital empire using free tiers like Termux and GitHub Actions.
product_angles: Pre-configured GitHub Actions workflow templates for automated social media posting and asset generation.
Termux shell scripts for local batch processing of images and metadata on Android devices.
Markdown-based inventory databases compatible with GitHub and Obsidian.
proposals.first_test_product: GitHub Actions Auto-Publisher Template Pack (Workflow files + setup guide in markdown)
